data.title: 伊莉雅丝菲尔 · 圣杯战争
data.description: 【伊莉雅 · 圣杯战争】烈火燃烧的废墟战场上，娇小的伊莉雅傲然端坐在庞大如巨山的狂战士（Berserker）肩头，狂风肆虐吹乱她的银白长发。她俯视着战场发出银铃般清脆的笑声——「Berserker，把阻挡在大哥哥面前的敌对从者全部碾碎！这就是爱因兹贝伦的力量！」
data.location: 冬木市燃烧的街道废墟
data.camera: wide low-angle two-character shot, full Berserker figure and Illya seated on his shoulder
data.promptProse: Illyasviel sits securely on Berserker's broad shoulder and extends one commanding hand toward the distant battlefield, purple winter coat and white hair lifting in the wind. He stands planted on broken Fuyuki paving, battle skirt, greaves and lowered weapon visible beneath her. The wide low-angle view includes both complete figures. Firelight outlines their near sides and rubble; moonlight separates Illya's confident silhouette from smoke above the ruined street.
